#
# Argus RUNTIME dependency lock — fully pinned, hash-verified.
#
# The image installs with `pip install --require-hashes`, so a tampered or
# resolved-differently wheel is a build failure, not a silent substitution. This
# is what makes "roll back by redeploying the previous image tag" actually mean
# something: the tag pins the code AND every transitive dependency.
#
# Runtime only — the `dev` extra (pytest) is deliberately absent so no test
# tooling reaches the final image.
#
# REGENERATE whenever pyproject.toml's `dependencies` change:
#
#   ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"     # brings in pip-tools
#   ./.venv/bin/pip-compile --generate-hashes --no-emit-index-url \
#       --strip-extras --output-file=requirements.txt pyproject.toml
#
